title: Saw sharper UAP video on the inside than released footage

tellings.quote: I've definitely been exposed to a mix of quality both in terms of the visual fidelity and in the resolution of what this object is.

plain: Matthew Brown, who presents himself as a Pentagon whistleblower, says that from around 2018 he was shown videos of UAP, the government's newer term for unidentified flying objects. He says the footage he saw on the inside varied in quality, some of it much sharper and clearer about what the object was than anything released to the public. If true, it would mean the government holds better evidence than it has shown.
